items.headline: Mizuho Initiates BlackRock at Outperform With $1,450 Price Target
items.summary: Mizuho has initiated coverage of BlackRock, Inc. with an 'Outperform' rating and a price target of $1,450.

items.headline: NVIDIA Issues Warning to Chip Buyers Regarding US Export Compliance
items.summary: NVIDIA has cautioned customers about potential US legal risks associated with providing remote access to advanced chips for Chinese firms.

items.headline: Microsoft Expands Use of Haivision Live Video Ecosystem
items.summary: Microsoft has selected Haivision's video transport and control solutions to support the production of over 600 global events annually.

items.headline: BlackRock Participates in Bajaj Finance Private Share Offering
items.summary: BlackRock, alongside other institutional investors, participated in a $1.2 billion private share offering by Bajaj Finance.

items.headline: BlackRock Discloses Voting Rights in Mercedes-Benz Group AG
items.summary: BlackRock, Inc. filed a regulatory notification disclosing a change in its voting rights in Mercedes-Benz Group AG.

items.headline: NVIDIA Establishes National Security and Export Control Oversight Committee
items.summary: NVIDIA has formed a new board-level committee to oversee national security policies, export control compliance, and global trade risk management.

items.headline: Microsoft Releases Preliminary Report on Recent 365 Service Outage
items.summary: Microsoft issued a preliminary post-incident report attributing the recent Microsoft 365 service disruption to a latent software defect and network capacity issues.

items.headline: Vertex Pharmaceuticals Officer Sells $8.37 Million in Common Stock
items.summary: Charles F. Wagner Jr., an officer at Vertex Pharmaceuticals, sold 15,300 shares of common stock valued at approximately $8.37 million.

items.headline: Teamsters Organize Rally for Terminated Amazon Delivery Drivers in New York City
items.summary: The Teamsters union is organizing a rally to support 200 delivery drivers who were dismissed after Amazon terminated its contract with their third-party employer.

items.headline: Instagram Launches Integration for Amazon Affiliate Links
items.summary: Instagram has introduced a new feature allowing creators to directly integrate Amazon affiliate links into Reels and feed posts.

items.headline: BlackRock Reports Change in Voting Rights in Smiths Group
items.summary: BlackRock, Inc. disclosed a reduction in its total voting rights in Smiths Group, moving from 12.97% to 12.61%.

items.headline: BlackRock Investment Institute Warns of Potential AI Buildout Slowdown Impact
items.summary: Jean Boivin, head of the BlackRock Investment Institute, highlighted the risk that a deceleration in AI infrastructure investment could have material consequences for U.S. economic growth.

items.headline: Amnesty International Reports Continued Labor Issues at Amazon Saudi Arabia Facilities
items.summary: Amnesty International has alleged that migrant workers at Amazon facilities in Saudi Arabia continue to face exploitation, including misleading recruitment practices and wage issues.

items.headline: Court Grants Intervention in Broadcom and VMware Legal Case
items.summary: The President of the Fourth Chamber of the General Court has granted the ACC leave to intervene in support of Broadcom and VMware in Case T-280/26.

items.headline: Morgan Stanley Adjusts Price Target on Everest Group, Ltd. to $425
items.summary: Morgan Stanley has revised its price target for Everest Group, Ltd. (NYSE: EG) from $395 to $425.

items.headline: Morgan Stanley Adjusts Price Target on Arch Capital to $113 From $103
items.summary: Morgan Stanley has revised its price target for Arch Capital Group Ltd., increasing it from $103 to $113.

items.headline: OCEANE Global Enters Saudi Market with SNB Capital to Provide Liquidity for SAB Invest Hong Kong ETF
items.summary: OCEANE Global for Market Making LLC has entered the Saudi capital market to provide liquidity for the SAB Invest Hang Seng Hong Kong ETF through a collaboration with SNB Capital.

items.headline: Moody's Ratings Affirms WellSpan Health's Aa3 Bond Rating
items.summary: Moody's Ratings has affirmed the Aa3 bond rating for WellSpan Health, maintaining a stable outlook for the integrated health system.

items.headline: General Motors Plans to Increase Automation at North American Factories
items.summary: General Motors has announced a strategic plan to increase the use of robots and automation by 20% across its North American manufacturing facilities by 2028.

items.headline: Signify Extends Supply Contract with Mercedes-AMG Petronas F1 Team
items.summary: Signify N.V. has announced the extension of its supply agreement with the Mercedes-AMG Petronas Formula One Team.

items.headline: Mizuho Initiates Coverage of Apollo Global Management with Outperform Rating
items.summary: Mizuho has initiated coverage on Apollo Global Management, Inc. with an 'Outperform' rating and a price target of $145.

items.headline: Stifel Initiates Coverage of AutoZone with Hold Rating
items.summary: Stifel has initiated coverage on AutoZone, Inc. with a "Hold" rating and a price target of $3,450.

items.headline: Sony Sells Automotive Camera Business to Foxconn
items.summary: Sony has reached an agreement to sell its automotive camera business to Foxconn.

items.headline: UBS AG Updates Rating and Price Target for Richemont
items.summary: UBS AG raised its price target for Richemont to 215 CHF from 210 CHF and maintained a "Buy" rating.

items.headline: UBS Downgrades Shoals Technologies Group to Neutral
items.summary: UBS downgraded Shoals Technologies Group from "Buy" to "Neutral" with a price target of $9.

items.headline: Morgan Stanley and Jefferies Update Nucor Analyst Ratings and Price Targets
items.summary: Financial analysts at Morgan Stanley and Jefferies issued updated ratings and price targets for Nucor Corporation on November 17, 2026.

items.headline: Nebius Group N.V. Insider Sold Shares Worth $519,564
items.summary: Nebius Group N.V. reported an insider share sale valued at $519,564 in a recent SEC filing.

items.headline: Lufthansa Proposes Pilot Hiring and Promotions to Resolve Labor Dispute
items.summary: Lufthansa has presented a new offer to the Vereinigung Cockpit (VC) pilots' union following the conclusion of mediation, aiming to resolve ongoing labor conflicts.

items.headline: European Commission Approves Joint Control of Thales Norway by Thales and Kongsberg
items.summary: The European Commission has granted regulatory approval for Thales and Kongsberg to exercise joint control over Thales Norway.

items.headline: UniCredit Estimates Up to EUR 2 Billion in Value from Generali Partnerships
items.summary: UniCredit announced that its commercial partnerships with Generali are expected to generate up to EUR 2 billion in value.

items.headline: UniCredit Expects Polish Regulatory Approval for Commerzbank Stake by Month-End
items.summary: UniCredit CEO Andrea Orcel stated that the bank expects to receive the final necessary regulatory approval from Poland by the end of November to proceed with its Commerzbank strategy.

items.headline: BofA Resumes Coverage of Ageas with Underperform Rating
items.summary: Bank of America has resumed its coverage of Ageas, assigning the stock an 'Underperform' rating.

items.headline: Temenos Wins Charity Bank Deal to Modernize Core Banking and Payments Platform
items.summary: Temenos has secured a contract with Charity Bank to modernize the financial institution's core banking and payments infrastructure.

items.headline: Mizuho Initiates Coverage of Blackstone Inc. With Outperform Rating
items.summary: Mizuho has initiated coverage on Blackstone Inc. with an 'Outperform' rating and a price target of $139.

items.headline: Uniper and VNG Produce First Green Hydrogen at Bad Lauchstädt Facility
items.summary: Uniper and VNG have successfully produced their first green hydrogen at a 30 MW electrolyzer facility located at the Bad Lauchstädt Energy Park in Saxony-Anhalt, Germany.

items.headline: Pirelli Shareholder Sinochem Reduces Stake to 14%
items.summary: Chinese state-owned enterprise Sinochem has further reduced its stake in Italian tire manufacturer Pirelli, selling a 6.5% block of shares.

items.headline: B. Riley Adjusts Lumentum Price Target to $659
items.summary: B. Riley has lowered its price target for Lumentum Holdings Inc. from $770 to $659 while maintaining a Neutral rating.

items.headline: ING Groep Partners With Amundi to Launch New ETFs
items.summary: ING Groep has entered into a partnership with Amundi to launch a new series of exchange-traded funds (ETFs).

items.headline: Pizza Hut Partners with Pepsi and Josh Allen for Marketing Campaign
items.summary: Pizza Hut has launched a new marketing campaign featuring Pepsi and NFL player Josh Allen to promote its 'Triple Treat Box' holiday offering.

items.headline: TENA Releases Research on Men's Health and Incontinence
items.summary: Essity's TENA brand released new research highlighting the impact of urine leaks on men's social participation and mental well-being.
